6. Self-review, report

1: # GitHub Pages Marketing Site Design
2: 
3: **Date:** 2026-10-18
4: **Status:** Approved (design authority delegated to the session designer; all builder-check questions answered)
5: **Scope:** Single-page customer-facing site in `website/` + GitHub Actions deploy to GitHub Pages
6: 
7: ## Intent & Why
8: 
9: `README.md` is the project's front door, and it reads like an engineering changelog — right for
10: contributors, wrong for the PM or eng lead who clicked a shared link asking "is this real, and is it
11: worth five minutes?" The site answers why/what/how/when in one scroll, with a Jobsian bar:
12: ruthless focus, one narrative, one obvious action, craft in type and motion, and honesty as the
13: brand — the project is an experimental testbed, and the page says so out loud.
14: 
15: The Jobsian constraint that shapes everything: **over-promising on an experimental product is the
16: one thing Jobs never did — the honest answer is the Jobsian answer.** No dates, no maturity theater,
17: no CTAs that dead-end behind auth, no screenshots of vaporware.
18: 
19: Definition of done for the build (see plan): PR pushed with all GitHub Actions checks green —
20: lint (ruff), typecheck (mypy), security (bandit), tests (pytest ×6 packages + `website`), smoke,
21: and the "CI green" aggregate.
22: 
23: ## Audience & Jobs-to-be-Done
24: 
25: **Primary — product managers / innovation leads.** Landing cold from a shared link, a search, or a
26: referral. Skeptical of AI-tool marketing.
27: > When I open this page from a link in Slack, I want to know within one screen whether this is a
28: > real, runnable thing grounded in a method I respect, so I can decide to spend five minutes on it
29: > or leave without guilt.
30: 
31: **Secondary — AI/agent developers.** Evaluating whether to wire agents to an ODI data source.
32: > When I'm deciding what context to give my agents, I want the exact endpoint and a copy-paste
33: > quickstart that works locally, so I can try it without talking to anyone.
34: 
35: **Tertiary — the sharing PM (internal champion).** Forwarding the link to a team or a boss.
36: > When I forward this page, I want it to frame the thesis — evidence over opinion — credibly and
37: > soberly, so the conversation starts from the idea instead of from my credibility.
38: 
39: ## Messaging Hierarchy
40: 
41: Binding copy contract (tests enforce the marked strings; micro-polish — punctuation-level tweaks —
42: is builder latitude).
43: 
44: | Level | Copy |
45: |---|---|
46: | Eyebrow pill | `Experimental` |
47: | H1 (hero) | **Your roadmap is a guess.** |
48: | Hero sub | An MCP server that hands your agents verified customer outcomes — and the evidence behind them. |
49: | Primary CTA | **Run it in 60 seconds** → `#run` (local quickstart) |
50: | Secondary CTA | View on GitHub → `https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi` |
51: | Tertiary link | Hosted demo — requires a free Prefect account → Horizon chat URL |
52: | Footer tagline | Built with outcomes, not guesses. |
53: 
54: **Section 2 — `#problem`, "Opinion is expensive."** Three parallel beats, one line each, each with
55: a short support line:
56: 
57: 1. "Roadmaps set by whoever talks loudest." — Decisions default to seniority, not evidence.
58: 2. "Features for customers who never asked." — Nobody validated the outcome; only the idea.
59: 3. "Agents fluent in everything, grounded in nothing." — A model will confidently invent your customer.
60: 
61: Section closer: "Add it up and the roadmap isn't a plan. It's a guess."
62: 
63: **Section 3 — `#insight`, "Ask for outcomes, not opinions."** Three plain sentences:
64: 1. Outcome-Driven Innovation asks customers how much each desired outcome matters and how satisfied
65:    they are with it today.
66: 2. The gap between importance and satisfaction is where products win or die.
67: 3. Agentic ODI stores those outcomes, scores them, and serves them to any agent over MCP.
68: 
69: Then: a small CSS/inline-SVG bar visual (Importance vs Satisfaction, gap highlighted, labeled
70: "Illustrative outcome data"), the formula rendered exactly as the code computes it —
71: `Opportunity = Importance + max(Importance − Satisfaction, 0)` (source of truth:
72: `core/src/core/models.py:27`), and the stat callout: **86%** innovation success rate — *as reported
73: in ODI literature (Strategyn)*. Plain-text attribution only; no link to the in-repo PDF.
74: 
75: **Section 4 — `#how`, "How it works."** Three steps:
76: 1. **Capture** — jobs, steps, and desired outcomes with importance/satisfaction scores, via CLI,
77:    connectors, or The Living Studio.
78: 2. **Query** — agents call MCP tools for job maps and opportunity scores at decision time, local or
79:    hosted.
80: 3. **Steer** — The Living Studio shows the Opportunity Landscape, Universal Job Map, and Impact
81:    Simulation so the team decides from the same picture.
82: 
83: Accompanies: a stylized Studio illustration (real shipped surfaces, marked "Illustrative"), never a
84: fake screenshot.
85: 
86: **Section 5 — `#run`, "Run it in 60 seconds."** Prerequisites line (Python 3.10+, uv), terminal
87: block with copy button:
88: 
89: ```bash
90: git clone https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi.git
91: cd agentic-odi
92: uv sync --all-packages
93: python -m client.run
94: ```
95: 
96: Endpoint chips with copy buttons: MCP `http://localhost:8000/mcp` · Studio `http://localhost:8501`.
97: MCP client config snippet (local only):
98: 
99: ```json
100: {
101:   "mcpServers": {
102:     "agentic-odi": { "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp" }
103:   }
104: }
105: ```
106: 
107: Prose note: hosted credentials come from the maintainers — open an issue. Never invent an auth
108: scheme we cannot document.
109: 
110: **Section 6 — `#status`, "Honest status."** `Experimental` badge; **What works today** (MCP server
111: tools for jobs/steps/outcomes/customer outcomes with opportunity scoring; The Living Studio —
112: Opportunity Landscape, Universal Job Map, Impact Simulation, Causal Lineage; CLI `outcomes` +
113: `connectors`; MCP ingest connector; hosted test endpoints requiring auth) and **What's next**
114: (curated from the README roadmap at build time: map ingested evidence onto ODI artifacts, more
115: connector kinds, ODI schema definition, context tooling, persistence layer, agentic integration).
116: Standing line: "We don't publish dates. This page changes when the code does." Closer: "Questions?
117: Open an issue." → Issues link.
118: 
119: **Footer.** Mark + wordmark, tagline, links (GitHub, Issues, Hosted demo), legal line:
120: `© 2026 Agentic ODI maintainers · All rights reserved` + one-line experimental reminder.
121: 
122: **Voice rules:** warm, direct, second person; plain language; no jargon dumps; **no emoji anywhere
123: on the site** (house copy rule from the first-run onboarding spec — README's emoji style stays in
124: README); no superlatives ("revolutionary", "seamless", "enterprise-grade"); English only.
125: 
126: ## Information Architecture / Sitemap
127: 
128: | Route | File | Notes |
129: |---|---|---|
130: | `/` | `website/index.html` | The entire site. One scroll, seven sections. |
131: | `/404.html` | `website/404.html` | On-brand, **self-contained** (inline styles, absolute link home) so it renders at any depth on project Pages. |
132: 
133: - Sticky compact header: mark + wordmark (left), single CTA "Run it in 60 seconds" (right). No nav
134:   links — one page needs no navigation, but the one obvious action must stay reachable.
135: - In-page anchors: `#problem`, `#insight`, `#how`, `#run`, `#status`.
136: - No sitemap.xml, no robots.txt, no blog, no docs pages, no search.
137: 
138: ## Visual Direction
139: 
140: **Type.** No webfonts, zero downloads:
141: - `--font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif`
142:   (same stack The Living Studio ships, `client/src/client/app.py:36`)
143: - `--font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace`
144: 
145: | Role | Size | Weight / tracking |
146: |---|---|---|
147: | H1 | `clamp(2.75rem, 6.5vw, 4.75rem)` | 700, `-0.02em`, lh 1.05 |
148: | H2 | `clamp(1.75rem, 3.2vw, 2.5rem)` | 700, `-0.015em`, lh 1.15 |
149: | H3 / beats | `1.25rem` | 600, lh 1.3 |
150: | Body / lead | `1.0625rem` (17px) / `1.1875rem` | 400, lh 1.6 |
151: | Eyebrow, badges | `0.75rem` | 600, `0.08em`, uppercase |
152: | Code | `0.9375rem` mono | lh 1.55 |
153: 
154: **Color.** Tokens as CSS custom properties; `:root` = light, `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`
155: overrides. Palette echoes the shipped Studio dark-glass theme (`#0B0D13` / `#131722` / `#F1F5F9`
156: straight from `app.py`). All ratios measured, WCAG 2.1 AA (text ≥ 4.5:1):
157: 
158: | Token | Light | Dark | Contrast (light / dark) |
159: |---|---|---|---|
160: | `--bg` | `#ffffff` | `#0b0d13` | — |
161: | `--surface` | `#f5f5f7` | `#131722` | — |
162: | `--text` | `#1d1d1f` | `#f1f5f9` | 16.8 on bg / 17.7 on bg |
163: | `--muted` | `#6e6e73` | `#94a3b8` | 5.07 bg, 4.66 surface / 7.58 bg, 6.98 surface |
164: | `--accent` (button fill, white label) | `#0071e3` | `#0071e3` | white on it: 4.70 (both) |
165: | `--accent-text` (link text) | `#0062c4` | `#409cff` | 5.93 bg, 5.44 surface / 6.86 bg, 6.32 surface |
166: | `--accent-hover` | `#0059b8` | `#0059b8` | white on it: 6.73 |
167: | `--badge` (fg on bg) | `#475569` on `#e2e8f0` | `#cbd5e1` on `#1e293b` | 6.15 / 9.85 |
168: | `--border` | `rgba(0,0,0,.08)` | `rgba(148,163,184,.16)` | decorative only |
169: 
170: Code blocks are dark (`#0b0d13`) in both schemes — a terminal is a terminal (17.7:1 either way).
171: OG card is fixed dark, self-contained.
172: 
173: **Layout & spacing.** Mobile-first; content max-width 1080px, prose max-width 68ch; inline padding
174: `clamp(20px, 5vw, 40px)`; section padding-block `clamp(72px, 12vw, 140px)`; 8px spacing scale as
175: custom properties; radius 12px cards / 999px pills (echoing the Studio's own radii); 1px hairline
176: borders. Beats and steps go two-column at ≥720px.
177: 
178: **Motion.** Restrained, explanatory, never load-bearing:
179: - Hero stagger on load: eyebrow → H1 → sub → CTAs, 12px fade-up, 60ms stagger, 400ms,
180:   `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` — pure CSS, no JS.
181: - Scroll reveal: sections fade-up once when 15% visible (IntersectionObserver). Default state is
182:   **visible**; JS opts content into the hidden-then-reveal state only after it loads, so no-JS
183:   readers never see hidden content.
184: - Buttons: 150ms `background-color`/`transform`, hover `translateY(-1px)`, active `scale(.98)`.
185: - Copy button swaps its label to "Copied" for 1.5s, announced via an `aria-live="polite"` span.
186: - `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`: all transforms/stagger removed, reveals off, content
187:   immediate.
188: 
189: **Imagery & assets (none exist in the repo — all created):**
190: - **Mark** (`mark.svg`, hand-authored, viewBox `0 0 32 32`): rounded-square canvas with an
191:   ascending two-step polyline and a filled dot at the apex — the opportunity curve breaking
192:   upward. Accent stroke `#0071e3`, hairline frame. Works at 16px, single color-safe.
193: - **Favicon:** `favicon.svg` (same geometry) + `favicon.png` 32×32 (generated, dark tile, for
194:   browsers that ignore SVG icons).
195: - **Opportunity visual:** pure CSS/inline SVG bars in `#insight`, `aria`-labeled, marked
196:   "Illustrative outcome data".
197: - **Studio illustration:** stylized abstraction of shipped surfaces only (Opportunity Landscape,
198:   Universal Job Map, Impact Simulation — verified in `client/src/client/app.py:683-838`), marked
199:   "Illustrative". Depicting vaporware on a page whose thesis is "no guesses" would self-destruct.
200: - All decorative SVGs `aria-hidden="true"`; no stock photos, no icon fonts, no emoji.
201: 
202: ## Content Sources
203: 
204: | Content | Source | Enforcement |
205: |---|---|---|
206: | Quickstart commands (`uv sync --all-packages`, `python -m client.run`) | README §Getting Started — **verbatim** | `test_readme_sync.py` |
207: | Local endpoints (`http://localhost:8000/mcp`, `http://localhost:8501`) | README One-Command Launch — **verbatim** | `test_readme_sync.py` |
208: | Hosted chat URL | README §Deployment — **verbatim**; the label "requires a free Prefect account" is fresh | `test_readme_sync.py` + allowlist |
209: | Experimental framing, maturity claims | README banner — adapted, no new claims | review + honesty tests |
210: | What works today / What's next | README roadmap checkboxes, curated at build time (re-read README in Task 2 of the plan) | review focus |
211: | License/legal line | README §License — adapted ("All rights reserved") | honesty test |
212: | 86% stat + "as reported in ODI literature (Strategyn)" | Session decision (no link to `knowledge/*.pdf`) | honesty test |
213: | Opportunity formula | `core/src/core/models.py:27-29` | formula test |
214: | Headline, subhead, beats, section titles, CTA labels, tagline, OG copy | **Written fresh** — binding in this spec | structural tests |
215: | Mark, favicon, illustrations, OG art | Created per this spec | asset tests |
216: 
217: Rule: README is the source of truth for every command, URL, and status claim. If the page and
218: README disagree, the page is wrong.
219: 
220: ## Technical Approach
221: 
222: Hand-crafted static HTML + one CSS file + ≤100 lines of vanilla JS. **No framework** (no
223: Astro/Next/React): one page with no routing, no state, no data, no components shared across
224: views — a framework buys a toolchain, a lockfile, hydration, and an upgrade treadmill, and charges
225: rent on every one of them. Consequence of no framework: deploy is "copy files", the review diff is
226: readable HTML, Lighthouse is high by construction, and there is zero supply chain on the page.
227: 
228: ```
229: website/
230:   index.html            # the site
231:   404.html              # self-contained fallback
232:   assets/
233:     style.css           # tokens + full design system (no external URLs)
234:     main.js             # ≤100 lines: reveal + copy buttons, defer, progressive enhancement
235:     mark.svg  favicon.svg
236:     og.png    favicon.png   # committed, generated (see OG strategy)
237:   tools/
238:     make_og.py          # regenerates og.png + favicon.png (Pillow, pinned)
239:   tests/
240:     test_site.py  test_assets.py  test_make_og.py
241:     test_workflows.py  test_readme_sync.py
242: ```
243: 
244: - **Paths:** every in-page URL is **relative** (`assets/…`, `#anchor`) so the site works under the
245:   project-Pages base `/agentic-odi/`, on a local static server, and on any future custom domain.
246:   `og:url` / `og:image` / `rel=canonical` are **absolute**.
247: - Local preview: `python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory website` (preview the 404 by opening
248:   `/404.html` directly — `http.server` serves its own 404).
249: - JS is `defer`'d and additive: the page is complete, styled, and readable with JS disabled.
250: - Python tooling lives only in `tools/` + `tests/`, run from the repo root with the workspace venv.
251: 
252: ## OG / Social Strategy
253: 
254: Social previews are the main earned-distribution artifact — one committed raster, no mystery binary.
255: 
256: - `website/assets/og.png`: **1200×630**, fixed dark card — mark + "Agentic ODI" wordmark,
257:   headline "Your roadmap is a guess.", sub "Verified customer outcomes, jobs, and opportunity
258:   scores — served over MCP.", bottom row `alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi` + Experimental badge.
259: - `website/tools/make_og.py`: the committed, runnable generator (stdlib argparse + Pillow). Writes
260:   `og.png` and `favicon.png`; defaults embed the canonical card copy above. Deterministic output —
261:   fixed palette/positions, no timestamps, `compress_level=9`, font via
262:   `ImageFont.load_default(size=…)` (Pillow's embedded Aileron, SIL OFL — no font file in the repo).
263:   Run: `uv run python website/tools/make_og.py`.
264: - **Regenerability is enforced:** `test_make_og.py` renders fresh bytes and asserts they are
265:   pixel-identical to the committed PNGs. Change the script → the test fails until you regenerate.
266:   Change the card copy → defaults in the script are the source.
267: - Meta contract on `index.html`: `og:type=website`, `og:site_name`, `og:title`
268:   ("Your roadmap is a guess. — Agentic ODI"), `og:description`, `og:url` (canonical Pages URL),
269:   `og:image` (absolute PNG URL), `twitter:card=summary_large_image` + title/description/image,
270:   `rel=canonical`, `theme-color` per color scheme, both favicons. Title tag ≤ 60 chars:
271:   `Agentic ODI — Ground agents in verified customer outcomes`.
272: - og:image is never loaded by the page itself (page weight unaffected).
273: - No OpenGraph on SVG: scrapers (X, LinkedIn, Slack, iMessage) need raster — hence exactly one PNG.
274: 
275: ## Deploy Pipeline
276: 
277: **`.github/workflows/pages.yml`** (deploy only — its contract is tested in `ci.yml` via
278: `test_workflows.py`, so PRs validate it without triggering a deploy):
279: 
280: - `on: push branches [main] paths [website/**, .github/workflows/pages.yml]`, plus
281:   `workflow_dispatch`.
282: - Workflow permissions: `contents: read`, `pages: write`, `id-token: write`. Concurrency:
283:   `group: pages`, `cancel-in-progress: false`. Environment: `github-pages` (URL from the
284:   deployment step).
285: - Job `deploy`, steps: checkout@v7 → `./.github/actions/setup` → **run
286:   `uv run pytest website/tests -q` (verify before publish)** → `actions/configure-pages@v6` →
287:   stage the artifact with
288:   `mkdir -p _site && rsync -a --exclude tests/ --exclude tools/ website/ _site/` →
289:   `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5` (`path: _site`) → `actions/deploy-pages@v5`.
290:   Only the site publishes — tests and generator never do; `_site/` is CI-only and gitignored.
291: - **Manual gate:** repository Settings → Pages → Source = "GitHub Actions" must be set **before
292:   this workflow first runs on `main`**, or the deploy job fails. (One-time toggle; flag before
293:   merge.)
294: 
295: **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**: add a `website` job (setup + `uv run pytest website/tests -q`,
296: timeout 10m) and add `website` to `ci-green`'s `needs`. Root `ruff check .` / `ruff format --check .`
297: already cover `website/**` once root ruff config exists (below).
298: 
299: ## Accessibility & Performance Budget
300: 
301: **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA):**
302: - Semantic landmarks (`header`/`main`/`footer`), one `h1`, no skipped heading levels, `lang="en"`.
303: - Contrast: measured pairs in the color table — every text pair ≥ 4.5:1 in both schemes.
304: - Full keyboard operability; visible focus ring (≥ 3:1 against adjacent colors); copy controls are
305:   real `<button>`s with accessible names; `aria-live` for "Copied".
306: - Decorative SVG `aria-hidden="true"`; meaningful links (no "click here"); `prefers-reduced-motion`
307:   respected; viewport meta; tested at 360px width with no horizontal scroll.
308: 
309: **Performance:**
310: - Zero third-party requests, zero webfonts, zero analytics, zero cookies — the page talks only to
311:   its own origin.
312: - Weights (raw, committed): HTML ≤ 60 KB, CSS ≤ 30 KB, JS ≤ 4 KB (≤ 100 non-blank lines), each SVG
313:   ≤ 10 KB, `favicon.png` ≤ 5 KB, total transferred ≤ 150 KB; `og.png` ≤ 300 KB (test-enforced;
314:   expected ~15–40 KB).
315: - Lighthouse ≥ 95 on Performance / Accessibility / Best Practices / SEO (mobile emulation,
316:   manual run before merge — CI has no browser).
317: 
318: ## Non-Goals / Anti-Goals
319: 
320: - **Not a docs site, not a blog.** No MkDocs/Docusaurus, no nav maze, no search, no sitemap.
321: - **No framework, no build step, no dependencies on the deployed artifact.**
322: - **No claims the repo can't back:** no dates or milestones; no "open source" or license claim
323:   (repo is all-rights-reserved); no maturity language beyond the Experimental framing; no invented
324:   testimonials, logos, customer counts, or benchmark numbers; no emoji.
325: - **No dead ends:** no CTAs behind auth (hosted is tertiary, labeled); no personal emails, no
326:   invented Discord/Slack; access channel = GitHub Issues only.
327: - **No auth fiction:** local MCP config only; never link the 401 `agentic-odi.fastmcp.app`
328:   endpoint as something a visitor can try; no invented header/token scheme.
329: - **No vaporware imagery:** Studio illustration is abstraction-of-shipped-surfaces, labeled
330:   "Illustrative"; no fake screenshots.
331: - **No hotlinking `knowledge/Strategyn_*.pdf`** — attribution text only.
332: - **No analytics/cookies/CDN/fonts/i18n** — scope is English, one page, two schemes.
333: - **No publishing dev files:** `website/tests/` and `website/tools/` never reach the Pages artifact.
334: 
335: ## Risks & Mitigations
336: 
337: 1. **Pages not enabled before first merge** → deploy job red on `main`. Mitigation: manual toggle
338:    flagged as a pre-merge gate in the plan's final task.
339: 2. **README drift** (commands/URLs change, page rots) → `test_readme_sync.py` fails CI.
340: 3. **Committed PNG drifts from generator** → pixel-identity test fails CI until regeneration.
341: 4. **Scope creep** (nav items, extra pages, webfonts) → anti-goals + structural tests (allowlisted
342:    links, weight budgets) push back mechanically.
343: 5. **Ruff newly covers `website/**`** → root config added at repo-consistent line length; commit
344:    steps run root lint/format parity before every commit.

1: """Generate the committed social art: website/assets/og.png and favicon.png.
2: 
3: Run from the repo root:
4: 
5:     uv run python website/tools/make_og.py
6: 
7: Output is deterministic - fixed palette, fixed positions, no timestamps, PNG
8: encoded with compress_level=9 and optimize=True - so website/tests/test_make_og.py
9: can assert the committed PNGs are pixel-identical to a fresh render.
10: """
11: 
12: from __future__ import annotations
13: 
14: import argparse
15: import io
16: from pathlib import Path
17: 
18: from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
19: 
20: OG_SIZE = (1200, 630)
21: FAVICON_SIZE = (32, 32)
22: 
23: DEFAULT_HEADLINE = "Your roadmap is a guess."
24: DEFAULT_SUBHEAD = "Verified customer outcomes, jobs, and opportunity scores — served over MCP."
25: DEFAULT_URL = "alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi"
26: 
27: CANVAS = (11, 13, 19)  # #0b0d13
28: SURFACE = (19, 23, 34)  # #131722
29: TEXT = (241, 245, 249)  # #f1f5f9
30: MUTED = (148, 163, 184)  # #94a3b8
31: ACCENT = (64, 156, 255)  # #409cff
32: BADGE_FG = (203, 213, 225)  # #cbd5e1
33: BADGE_BG = (30, 41, 59)  # #1e293b
34: HAIRLINE = (51, 65, 85)  # #334155
35: 
36: MARGIN = 64
37: PILL_LABEL = "Experimental"
38: WORDMARK = "Agentic ODI"
39: HEADLINE_SIZES = (84, 76, 68, 60, 52)  # shrink until the headline fits two lines
40: 
41: # Mark geometry, normalized inside its bounding box: an ascending two-step
42: # polyline (flat, riser, flat, riser, flat) ending in a filled apex dot.
43: _MARK_POINTS = (
44:     (0.16, 0.78),
45:     (0.42, 0.78),
46:     (0.42, 0.53),
47:     (0.66, 0.53),
48:     (0.66, 0.28),
49:     (0.84, 0.28),
50: )
51: 
52: 
53: def _wrap(
54:     draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw,
55:     text: str,
56:     font: ImageFont.ImageFont,
57:     max_width: float,
58: ) -> list[str]:
59:     """Greedy word wrap measured with draw.textlength."""
60:     lines: list[str] = []
61:     current = ""
62:     for word in text.split():
63:         candidate = word if not current else f"{current} {word}"
64:         if draw.textlength(candidate, font=font) <= max_width:
65:             current = candidate
66:         elif current:
67:             lines.append(current)
68:             current = word
69:         else:
70:             current = word
71:     if current:
72:         lines.append(current)
73:     return lines
74: 
75: 
76: def _draw_mark(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], line_width: int) -> None:
77:     x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
78:     width = x1 - x0 + 1
79:     height = y1 - y0 + 1
80:     draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=max(2, width // 4), fill=SURFACE, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)
81:     points = [(x0 + px * (width - 1), y0 + py * (height - 1)) for px, py in _MARK_POINTS]
82:     draw.line(points, fill=ACCENT, width=line_width, joint="curve")
83:     apex_x, apex_y = points[-1]
84:     radius = max(2, round(width * 0.09))
85:     draw.ellipse(
86:         (apex_x - radius, apex_y - radius, apex_x + radius, apex_y + radius),
87:         fill=ACCENT,
88:     )
89: 
90: 
91: def _draw_pill(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, label: str, right: int, cy: int) -> None:
92:     font = ImageFont.load_default(size=22)
93:     pad_x = 20
94:     height = 44
95:     width = round(draw.textlength(label, font=font)) + 2 * pad_x
96:     x1, y0 = right, cy - height // 2
97:     x0, y1 = x1 - width, y0 + height
98:     draw.rounded_rectangle((x0, y0, x1, y1), radius=height // 2, fill=BADGE_BG)
99:     draw.text(((x0 + x1) / 2, cy), label, font=font, fill=BADGE_FG, anchor="mm")
100: 
101: 
102: def _to_png(image: Image.Image) -> bytes:
103:     buffer = io.BytesIO()
104:     image.save(buffer, format="PNG", compress_level=9, optimize=True)
105:     return buffer.getvalue()
106: 
107: 
108: def render(
109:     headline: str = DEFAULT_HEADLINE,
110:     subhead: str = DEFAULT_SUBHEAD,
111:     url: str = DEFAULT_URL,
112: ) -> bytes:
113:     """Render the 1200x630 social card and return its PNG bytes."""
114:     width, height = OG_SIZE
115:     image = Image.new("RGB", OG_SIZE, CANVAS)
116:     draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
117: 
118:     draw.rounded_rectangle((24, 24, width - 25, height - 25), radius=28, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)
119: 
120:     mark_size = 44
121:     _draw_mark(draw, (MARGIN, MARGIN, MARGIN + mark_size - 1, MARGIN + mark_size - 1), 3)
122:     middle_y = MARGIN + mark_size // 2
123:     draw.text(
124:         (MARGIN + mark_size + 16, middle_y),
125:         WORDMARK,
126:         font=ImageFont.load_default(size=30),
127:         fill=TEXT,
128:         anchor="lm",
129:     )
130:     _draw_pill(draw, PILL_LABEL, right=width - MARGIN, cy=middle_y)
131: 
132:     text_width = width - 2 * MARGIN
133:     size = HEADLINE_SIZES[0]
134:     font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
135:     headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
136:     for size in HEADLINE_SIZES[1:]:
137:         if len(headline_lines) <= 2:
138:             break
139:         font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
140:         headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
141: 
142:     y = 200
143:     for line in headline_lines[:2]:
144:         draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=font, fill=TEXT)
145:         y += round(size * 1.25)
146: 
147:     subhead_font = ImageFont.load_default(size=28)
148:     y += 26
149:     for line in _wrap(draw, subhead, subhead_font, text_width):
150:         draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=subhead_font, fill=MUTED)
151:         y += 36
152: 
153:     draw.text(
154:         (MARGIN, height - MARGIN),
155:         url,
156:         font=ImageFont.load_default(size=26),
157:         fill=MUTED,
158:         anchor="ld",
159:     )
160:     return _to_png(image)
161: 
162: 
163: def render_favicon() -> bytes:
164:     """Render the 32x32 favicon tile (canvas + mark only) as PNG bytes."""
165:     image = Image.new("RGB", FAVICON_SIZE, CANVAS)
166:     draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
167:     _draw_mark(draw, (2, 2, 29, 29), 2)
168:     return _to_png(image)
169: 
170: 
171: def write(out_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
172:     """Write og.png and favicon.png into out_dir and return their paths."""
173:     out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
174:     og_path = out_dir / "og.png"
175:     favicon_path = out_dir / "favicon.png"
176:     og_path.write_bytes(render())
177:     favicon_path.write_bytes(render_favicon())
178:     return [og_path, favicon_path]
179: 
180: 
181: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
182:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate the site's og.png and favicon.png.")
183:     parser.add_argument(
184:         "--out",
185:         type=Path,
186:         default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets",
187:         help="directory to write og.png and favicon.png into (default: website/assets)",
188:     )
189:     args = parser.parse_args(argv)
190:     for path in write(args.out):
191:         print(f"wrote {path}")
192:     return 0
193: 
194: 
195: if __name__ == "__main__":
196:     raise SystemExit(main())

12: def _load():
13:     spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("make_og", TOOLS / "make_og.py")
14:     mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
15:     spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

19: def _dims(png: bytes) -> tuple[int, int]:
20:     assert png[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "not a PNG"
21:     w, h = struct.unpack(">II", png[16:24])  # IHDR: 8 sig + 4 len + 4 type, then width/height
22:     return w, h
23:

25: def test_render_is_deterministic_and_sized():
26:     m = _load()
27:     a = m.render()
28:     b = m.render()
29:     assert _dims(a) == (1200, 630)
30:     assert a == b

33: def test_favicon_is_sized():

35:     assert _dims(m.render_favicon()) == (32, 32)
